lessons.reason: The persistent RUN-842 source/request distinction, actual note round trip, changing tool membership, geometric prefix reorder, conserved allocation, cutoff pruning, strict handoff, protected-case failure and byte-bound resume checks make context construction inspectable. No material blocker was found in the sampled final movie.
